kicker: Strong guidance · FY27 revenue growth guided vs Q2 delivered
title: Guided 30%-plus growth, then beat it in Q2
dek: Syrma SGS guided 40–45% FY27 revenue growth and grew 73.6% in Q2; Aeroflex guided ~60% and grew 87%; HFCL guided at least 80% and grew 143.6%. Knowledge Marine and Cyient DLM fell short in the quarter.

chart.title: FY27 revenue growth guided vs Q2 FY27 revenue growth
chart.sub: % YoY · guide = midpoint given on the Q2 FY27 call · Q2 from filed consolidated results

quadrants.tl: Q2 well ahead of the guide

legend.a: Q2 growth at or above the guide

stats.note: FY27 guide raised to 40–45%, about ₹7,000 cr.

stats.note: Up from ₹1,000 cr for FY29; Q2 revenue rose 87%.

stats.note: Against a guide raised to ~80%; H1 FY27 was +89%.

read: Six of these eight are already growing at or above the full-year rate they promised; for them the risk in H2 is a high base, not a missed guide.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE and Q2 FY27 earnings calls
notes: Companies whose Q2 FY27 call gave a quantified FY27 revenue-growth guide of 30% or more, plotted at the guide's midpoint: HFCL 'at least 80%' (plotted at 80), Knowledge Marine ~80%, Aeroflex ~60% (₹715–725 cr), Syrma SGS 40–45%, GNG ~40%, Smartworks 33–35%, Cyient DLM 30–35% and Acutaas ~30%. Every guide shown was raised on or before the Q2 call except Aeroflex's and Cyient DLM's. Q2 growth is revenue from operations vs Q2 FY26 in filed consolidated results; a single quarter can run ahead of or behind a full-year guide on order timing. Knowledge Marine's H1 FY27 revenue grew 89%, so its slower Q2 does not by itself put the guide at risk; Cyient DLM's H1 growth was 30.2%.
